title: Lightlag Traverse
pitch: One mission of 420 ticks across 600 m by 400 m of Mars-like ground: 4 craters with steep walls, a scarp with 2 passes, sand, rock fields and bedrock. 46 science targets, 35 with a deadline, 8 found on the way. The sun charges the battery; every command arrives 3 ticks late. Gold is the reference controller. No model has driven this ground yet: the other rovers are scripted stand-ins.
